content:
Maya: Huge shoutout to @Sam and @Jordan from SRE for the late-night rescue — incident resolved in 23m, no customer impact 🎉
Alex: Unreal timing, thanks y'all :heart:
Sam: Team effort — Priya from CS triaged the customer repro while Jordan dug into logs. Also shout to Lina for the canary rollback script fix.
Priya: Happy to help! Quick note: added a repro case to the support playbook: https://redwood-internal/docs/playbooks/customer-repro
Jordan: Logs showed an NFS hiccup + config drift. Rolling forward the automerge fix now. @deploy-bot started canary at 02:14 UTC
OpsBot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout succeeded — 4/4 nodes healthy. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/canary/18077
Alex: Can we get a small pizza on Monday? :pizza: Maya volunteered to order :)
Maya: Ordering 2 large (1 gluten-free) + 1 vegan. Everyone add dietary prefs in the thread.
Lina: Added vegan + nut-free. Thanks for the shoutout, team :smile:
Sam: :thumbsup: Night shift crew deserves badges. Can someone add an "oncall hero" badge to the team kudos board?
Priya: Done — added to Kudos board: https://notion.redwood/kudos/ops-heroes
Maya: Also tagging Eng Leadership so this gets a mention in the next All-hands :tada: @Alex @Jordan
Alex: Will put a quick slide in the all-hands deck. Huge thanks again, everyone!
